wasm_abi: Silk dev27 wasm32 lowers single-scalar aggregate results recursively to their scalar: WGPUFuture returns i64 (JavaScript bigint), not an sret pointer. Multiscalar by-value aggregates are passed indirectly. Callback fields are u32 host-registered tokens; native function addresses are never reinterpreted.
nullable_callbacks: Native fn fields are nonnull. Callback-info constructors require a callback; raw C NULL callback defaults are intentionally not fabricated.
